# Set Up Shop Online

Put AI to work. Create capacity. Grow what matters.

Vlad Gutenmakher is an AI Consultant and Value Architect who helps small and midsized service businesses put AI to work where it matters most and turn it into measurable business value. He brings more than 30 years of business, technology, solution architecture, and implementation experience.

His vendor-neutral approach starts with the owner’s goals, people, customers, how work gets done, and what is getting in the way. Opportunities may include winning more work, improving customer experience, increasing capacity, improving quality, and reducing repetitive work. Priorities are weighed by value, cost, effort, and feasibility.

Start with the business, not the AI. The method is Understand → Define → Find → Prioritize → Implement → Adopt → Measure. Understand the business, define success, find opportunities, and prioritize by value, cost, effort, and feasibility. In broader engagements, implement the chosen solution, train and support the people adopting it, measure results, and improve before expanding.

Solution architecture, implementation, training, adoption support, and measurement are scoped separately from the one-hour AI Strategy Call. The goal is a stronger business: greater capacity, more freedom and choice.

## AI Strategy Call

Duration: one hour. With: Vlad Gutenmakher.

A focused working session on the client's most important business challenge, AI opportunity, or technology decision. Discuss the desired outcome, potential value, feasibility, constraints, tradeoffs, and sensible next steps.

The session does not include implementation, a completed architecture, a detailed roadmap, a written report, a recording, or follow-up support. It does not guarantee financial results.
